text_abccf2a40d3c: Choose a category and its reasons. A reason may belong to several categories. Existing entries are retained.
text_023ab76c7da5: This reason is not assigned to the selected category. Please select again.
text_fbf634cb29dd: The assignment changed in the meantime. Please reload.
text_90823a0948b5: The assignment contains invalid master data.
text_0ffb4a14e4a5: No linked work report is available. The GPS recording remains stored locally.
text_52bea1d7ba72: This entry has been completed or is no longer available. Please refresh the list.
text_fdeba38cfe2e: Beta diagnostics are available only to driver 787117.
text_0ffd21256410: Choose a contact to open the chat.
text_e9a16bfe6cbf: The message could not be loaded or sent. Your draft is retained.
text_10ad3c3704d2: View your assigned planned duties here. Continue recording actual working times in the work report.
text_54326bbe8493: Check the file, columns, date and driver assignment. Nothing was imported.
text_2c9ec087810c: Check every column and explicitly assign each imported row to a driver. Unselected rows are not published. Importing does not create work reports.
text_852308fc34ca: Read your planned duties, stations, times, locomotives, rotation names and handover notes.
text_a309f1ce4d74: Planning publishes only rows assigned to your account. CTL / preparation code and CTL / completion code show planned tasks; “keiner” and “weiter” remain notes. Rotation names and comments are preserved. Applied planned data is a proposal. Check and correct it to match your actual duty before synchronizing.
text_62dd936a2c8e: Open Duty roster from its tile or the button in the work report. In the report, the roster appears in a dialog. Close it with × to continue editing. An active GPS recording stays open. Previously loaded rosters are available offline in Android; new assignments appear after reconnecting.
text_4d17451b6e10: Choose the category first. The reason list then contains only active reasons assigned in master data. Change the category or ask administration if your reason is missing. Previously saved combinations are retained; new entries follow current assignments.
text_e6857d142fe0: Pending transfers shows actual local reports with duty start/end and GPS recordings with train number and start time. Completed entries disappear. Open entry takes you to the associated report or journey. Finish an active GPS recording before switching reports. If no report is found for a recording, a notice appears and the recording is retained. After an error, open the report and correct the marked row.
text_a223ce7aab55: Choose a contact, write and send a message, and optionally attach a file up to 10 MB. The conversation shows dates, times and read receipts for your own messages. Use ↩ to add a short quote to your draft. Search contacts on the left and messages in the open conversation. Older messages loads further entries. Text drafts are retained on this device separately for each contact. Re-select attachments after closing the page. Inbox, groups and forwarding retains multiple recipients, replies, forwarding and deleting. Group messages are kept separate from private chats.
